simple.meaning: מִשְׁקָע (mishqâʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a settling place (of water), i.e. a pond.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׁקָע (H4950) before moving outward to related references.
